form.name: Rent Plan Name
form.schedule_locked_tooltip: This rent plan is bound to {{.ClientName}}'s rate card.
form.schedule_auto_create_hint: No rate card exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.schedule_auto_reuse_hint: This rent plan will be added to the existing rate card for {{.ClientName}}.
form.schedule_client_picker_notice: Only rental plans assigned to this tenant are available below.
form.schedule_general_picker_notice: Lease offerings assigned specifically to tenants are not available for general rate cards.
form.parent_schedule_client_notice: This rate card belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Rent plans created here will be available only for leases with this tenant.
form.billing_kind_one_time_hint: Charged once at lease commencement. No further rent invoices fire on this lease.
form.billing_kind_recurring_hint: Billed every cycle until the lease is terminated.
form.billing_kind_contract_hint: Fixed-term lease with a defined expiry date. Rent can be billed periodically or as a single total.
form.billing_kind_milestone_hint: Invoice fires per milestone. Requires a Maintenance SOP on the parent Rental Plan.
form.plan_info: The rental plan this rent plan belongs to.
form.schedule_info: The rate card (effective date range + property or space) this rent plan belongs to.
form.name_info: Optional — defaults to the rental plan name when left blank.
form.description_info: Optional notes shown alongside the rent plan in detail views.
form.currency_info: Currency applied to this rent plan and any auto-seeded space prices.
form.term_info: How long the lease lasts. Leave empty for open-ended.
form.active_info: Inactive rent plans stay on record but are hidden from new leases.
form.escalation_record_only: Recorded clause only; rent invoices are not adjusted automatically.
form.escalation_invalid: Check the rent escalation mode, percentage, application and interval.
